description: 22 steps at a lectern with a comparator reading it: placed facing the player, a plain book refused, a three-page writable book put on and used up, its window (type 17, the book, the page property), next and previous pages with their pulses and the comparator's 1, 8 and 15, pages by number (clamped to the book), the book taken by its button into the inventory and the window closed, a one-page book reading 15, the lectern broken dropping itself and its book, a book put on in creative mode kept in the hand, and a click on the window's book slot taking the book; Circuit and both official servers give identical output
